segments.en: The war with the Redros Army was over, and our Claudia had found its calm again.
For the first time in ages, I'm flying around, nice and easy.
Flying like this, it almost feels like that war happened a long, long time ago.
Kanji, it's almost time.

Whoops!
Is it that time already?
Got it, I'll come down right away.

rows.notes: [editorial 3] 'it's about time' reads as 'finally!'; JP [jp] = it's nearly time

segments.en:
Oh, Kanji!
Good work today!

Hey, Lun!
You done with your work too?
Yes, I just wrapped up.

Hm...?
That's weird...
What's wrong?
Usually right about now, Rie would show up to nag me. Isn't she around?

Lieutenant Kanji!
Today's a day off, remember?

Oh, right...
I blew off last week's test flight, didn't I?
That's right. And thanks to that, I got dragged along too, you know.

Ha ha ha... Well~
That's true, huh.
Then you'll come shopping with me after this, won't you?
All right, all right. I'll carry your bags, or anything else you command.

Tee hee!
Then let's go!
The next day...
Astante II: Ops Room
Hey!! Skipping flight training?! That's unheard of!!

(Dad...
 He already caught wind of it, huh?)
(But this time, I really was slacking way too much. Guess I'll just own up and apologize...)

I was slacking off, sir.
I'll be more careful from now on!

What?!
What's gotten into you?
You're awfully meek.
He's definitely up to something...
Yeah... Whenever he's like this, he's hiding something even bigger...
You'd better come clean.
Dammit! Nobody trusts me at all! And here I am, actually sorry!
Fool! This isn't some trivial matter you can settle just by being sorry!
That's what I'm saying! This was all my fault. I'll accept any punishment you give me.
Hmmm... Very well... So you'll accept any punishment, will you?

Professor!
Is that thing ready to use?
Yes. I had a feeling it would come to this, so I got it ready.
It's a special simulation system I finished just yesterday.
Hear the explanation of the simulation system?

Hear it
Skip it
Wh-Wh-What are you gonna make me do?
Don't look so scared. It's just a training program.

Huh...
So how's it different from the ones before?
Let's see... Unlike the training simulators we've had until now, it lets you use a wide variety of machines, I suppose.
A wide variety of machines?
This simulation has been fed data on weapons and people from other worlds.
What's more, with this you can recreate every situation, from voyages across the continent to combat.
Whoa~ That sounds like fun.
In normal training, you're limited in the machine types you can use, so tactics end up set in stone.
But this is a groundbreaking system that solves that problem.
But why build a device like this?
We must always keep a watchful eye so that no one ever runs amok again the way Redros did.
An "emergency" is something we must never allow to happen.
And yet we must be prepared for when the time comes!
Therefore...
Enough with the lecture! Let's just get started already!

Agreed!
That'd be quicker.

Nngh!
B-But still...

Ha ha ha!
Oh, let it go.
Nelfea, Kanji's been rubbing off on you too, hasn't he?
Wha...! Don't say weird things! I was just being rational... Rational...

Hee hee!
Okay, here we go.
Starting the training program!

Beginning operation!
Deploying the virtual space field.

Hm...?
Nothing's changed, has it?

Hee hee!
Kanji, it's already started.
Surprised? Believe it or not, this is virtual space.
Huh...
What? So Kanji and I were the only ones who didn't know?
That's right! Everyone helped with the tests, so they've all done it once already.
Well then, let's have someone make an appearance!
There, that should do it. Could you two head over to the hangar?

Head over...
How?
Looks like you still haven't caught on.
You just walk there, like this!

Whoa!
Hey!
Quit pulling me!
There, we're here.
Why'd we have to go all the way to the hangar...
It only feels like we walked here. This is virtual space.
So what, then? You're telling me I could walk all the way home like this?
I'd imagine it only works in certain places, though.
Well, I'd guess anywhere you don't need for training is off-limits.

Long time no see,
Kanji.

Whoa!
Amuro?!
What are you doing here?!
What are you talking about? I've been assigned to the unit here.

Assigned...?
This is Claudia, you know!
Surprised, I bet. Well, that's how it works.
Recreating situations in a form true to reality is this simulator's selling point.
Resetting the situation. I'll place Amuro at his scheduled point.

Hm?
A reassignment?

Can't be helped...
See you again, Kanji.
Y-Yeah...

Whoa, whoa...
Is this for real...?
Listen up. Powerful enemy forces have been stationed at several strongholds.
Taking them down is your mission this time.
Once you've cleared a set number of missions, the Mediator will be deployed. Defeat it, and the training is over.
Roger! We'll figure out the rest as we go. Let's get started.

W-Wait!
I still have questions...
Then the exercise will now begin. Everyone, start moving!
Just like that?!
No complaining. Get to it, and be quick about it.
Yeah, yeah!

All right!
Let's give this a shot!

rows.notes: Seg 7 (Lun) [jp] kept as 'Captain Kanji' (teasing use of his rank); 'day off' explains Rie's absence. Seg 15 location card uses the UI string 'Astante II: Ops Room'. Seg 34 choice: 'Hear it / Skip it'. Seg 41 [jp] 'voyages across the continent' (land ships). Seg 85 [jp] -> 'Amuro', 'his' (Amuro male). segments.en:
Ready,
Big Bro?
Anytime!
Okay, first, pick which side you want to start on.
Side?
You can choose either us, the "Unified Forces," or the "Redros Army."
I can join the Redros Army?
Of course! But if you do, you and I will be enemies, Big Bro.
What'll you do?

Hmm...
What should I do...
Which side will you start on?

Redros Army
Claudian Unified Forces

All right!
I've decided!
As of now, I'm going over to the Redros Army!
Redros Army...

Redros Army flagship
Balket: Bridge
So you are Kanji Akatsuki, son of Kyo Akatsuki.
I am delighted that the day has come when we can fight side by side.
It may be painful to fight those who were your allies only yesterday, but
now that you've joined us, more soldiers will come over to our side.
I'm counting on you!

Hm?
You're...
Looks like you'll be stuck with me from now on.
Good to work with ya!
Never thought I'd end up forming a squadron with you people.
Well, at least I can trust you more than the others...

Lord Omega,
your next mission awaits.

Hm, is it time...?
Then, if you'll excuse me.
Kanji has been assigned to the Redros Army.
Kanji has been put in charge of Squad Setup.
Obtained 10000 funds.

Squad Setup, huh...
For now, I'll head to the hangar.

All right...
Time to check our deployment status.

Retrieving data.
Please wait a moment...

A moment...?
Does it take that long?

...Sure enough,
it's taking a while...

...Whoa, whoa.
Is there really that much data...?
Data retrieval complete.
That sure took a long time.
Still, there's a crazy number of machines and pilots registered in here...
Surprised?
Our fleet has gathered representatives from all over the world.
From all over the world...?
That's not all.
Because a great many instructor-class pilots have joined us,
it has become possible to open a "Training Center" within the fleet.
A "Training Center," sir...?
It means you can now receive "type" conversion training.
Though it is limited to the "types" from regions that mass-produce "general-purpose machines."
The merits you earn in battle qualify you for training on other types.
Huh...
I leave everything to you, including how the training is allocated.
I'm sure it will be quite a burden, but do your best.
Understood!
The Training Center has opened.
You can now assign "EXP" earned in battle to other types.
All right, let's get started.
The Unified Forces, obviously!

Let's do this,
Big Bro!
Let's do our best!
Yeah!
Rie! Let's head out right away!
Okay, okay!
But before that, check what's in your squad.
With the setup you've got now, you can't fight properly.
Oh, right... Gotta redo my Squad Setup...
Kanji has been assigned to the Claudian Unified Forces.
Obtained 10000 funds.

Squad Setup, huh...
For now, I'll head to the hangar.

All right...
Time to check our deployment status.

Retrieving data.
Please wait a moment...

A moment...?
Does it take that long?

...Sure enough,
it's taking a while...

...Whoa, whoa.
Is there really that much data...?
Data retrieval complete.
That sure took a long time.
Still, there's a crazy number of machines and pilots registered in here...
Surprised?
Our fleet has gathered representatives from all over the world.
From all over the world...?
That's not all.
Because a great many instructor-class pilots have joined us,
it has become possible to open a "Training Center" within the fleet.
A "Training Center"...?
It means you can now receive "type" conversion training.
Though it is limited to the "types" from regions that mass-produce "general-purpose machines."
The merits you earn in battle qualify you for training on other types.
Huh...
I leave everything to you, including how the training is allocated.
That is all!
The Training Center has opened.
You can now assign "EXP" earned in battle to other types.
All right, let's get started.

rows.notes: Seg 10 choice page, one option per line. Seg 13 'Redros Army...' is an unattributed narration card after the choice. Seg 17/18: one sentence split across pages, cut at the same point. Seg 23 [jp] plural -> 'you people' (Kanji and company; referents not shown). Seg 25 [jp] -> 'Sir Omega' (Aria to Omega, as in the main-story version). Seg 29 [jp] and seg 66 [jp] both -> 'Obtained 10000 funds.' (brief). Seg 39-51 header says Rochina, on the Redros side (kept; his formal register).
